hero.h1: Tax Advisory and Data Analysis Services
hero.subheading: We transform complex investment portfolios into precise, traceable tax reports ready to file with the AEAT. We combine data engineering with tax expertise to provide you with absolute clarity.

sections.body: At Cleriontax we specialize in two critical areas for investors with complex portfolios: financial data analysis and tax engineering. We work with investors operating across multiple platforms, exchanges, on-chain wallets and DeFi protocols, who need to consolidate thousands of transactions into verifiable tax reports compatible with the AEAT. Our approach combines advanced data processing technology with deep knowledge of Spanish tax regulations, applying FIFO, transaction classification and full traceability in every report we produce. We are not a generalist tax agency nor an automatic software: we are specialists at solving tax complexity through applied data engineering.

We offer four specialized services designed to cover the different needs investors with high-complexity portfolios face. Each service adapts to the sophistication of your portfolio and the level of automation you require.

subsections.title: Analysis of Complex Investment Portfolios
subsections.body: For investors with multiple data sources, hundreds of thousands of transactions and assets scattered across exchanges, brokers and blockchains. We integrate data from 50 or more platforms, apply advanced cleaning, reconciliation of duplicated transactions, and generate consolidated reports of performance, balances and operations. This service is essential if you operate with DeFi, multichain staking, airdrops or any decentralized investment structure. It includes data modeling, cross-validation, custom exports and full documentation for audits or tax requirements.

subsections.title: Tax Settlements and AEAT Forms
subsections.body: Complete preparation of your tax obligations: calculation of capital gains and losses using FIFO, investment income, tax scenario simulations and generation of forms 100, 721 and 714. We work with you to optimize your declaration within the legal framework, applying DGT criteria and current regulations. This service includes a full dossier with supporting documentation, justification of each calculation and review by certified tax advisors. Ideal if you have complex operations in cryptocurrencies, international stocks or multilayer tax structures.

subsections.title: Real-Time Portfolio Tracking
subsections.body: We connect your wallets and exchange accounts to tracking tools like CoinTracking to provide continuous visibility of your portfolio. You receive real-time dashboards, configurable alerts, consolidated balances and historical comparisons. This service is aimed at less complex portfolios that don't require advanced data engineering but do need constant monitoring and automated reporting. If your portfolio exceeds a certain complexity level, we will recommend our portfolio analysis service instead.

subsections.title: Specialized Tax Advisory
subsections.body: Personalized 1:1 sessions with our tax team to resolve specific questions about filing forms, classification criteria, regulatory compliance and report structure. We do not offer investment advice or recommendations on which assets to buy or sell. Our focus is technical and tax-oriented: we help you interpret regulations, prepare documentation for AEAT requirements and understand how to correctly apply tax criteria to your specific case. Includes document review, technical Q&A and post-session follow-up.

steps.title: Free initial evaluation
steps.body: Send us information about your platforms, approximate transaction volume and types of assets. We analyze your case within 24–48 hours and send you an initial diagnosis with no obligation. If your case requires advanced data analysis or complex tax preparation, we recommend the most suitable service.

steps.title: Scope and pricing definition
steps.body: You receive a proposal with a fixed price, specific deliverables, execution timeline and working methodology. No surprises or hidden costs. If you accept, we begin immediately with the collection and consolidation of your data.

steps.title: Execution and validation
steps.body: We process your data applying cleaning, reconciliation and tax classification. Each operation is manually reviewed when necessary. We generate intermediate reports for joint validation before delivering the final report.

steps.title: Delivery and ongoing support
steps.body: You receive your complete tax report, ready-to-file models and a review session to answer any questions. We offer post-delivery support throughout the entire tax season and for any request from the Spanish Tax Agency.

bullets: Investors with cryptocurrency portfolios across multiple exchanges, wallets and DeFi protocols who need to consolidate dispersed data into a single, traceable tax report.
Active traders with thousands of annual operations in stocks, futures, options or crypto assets requiring precise FIFO calculations and auditable documentation.
International investors with foreign assets who must comply with forms 720, 721 and 714 and need technical advice on fiscal transparency regulations.
Professionals and companies that manage treasury in cryptocurrencies, perform cross-border payments or participate in DeFi protocols as part of their economic activity.
Any investor with high tax complexity who has received incorrect automatic reports from third-party software and needs a professional review with real tax criteria.

items.q: What differentiates your service from automatic software like Koinly or CoinTracking?
items.a: Automatic software applies generic algorithms that do not account for the specificities of Spanish tax regulations, do not properly reconcile internal wallet movements and generate errors in the classification of complex DeFi operations. We apply human tax criteria, manual review of critical operations and personalized data modeling for each case. Our approach combines technology with tax expertise, ensuring traceability, accuracy and real regulatory compliance.

items.q: Do you only work with cryptocurrencies or also with stocks and other assets?
items.a: We work with any type of financial asset: cryptocurrencies, stocks, ETFs, futures, options, bonds, investment funds and alternative assets. Our specialization lies in the complexity of data analysis and tax engineering, not in a specific asset class. If you have a mixed portfolio with multiple data sources, we can consolidate it fully.

items.q: How long does the full process take from first contact to delivery of the tax report?
items.a: It depends on complexity. Simple cases with few platforms and moderate volume can be completed in 5–7 business days. Complex portfolios with more than 50 data sources, hundreds of thousands of transactions and DeFi operations may require 2 to 4 weeks. In the initial evaluation we will give you a precise timeline based on your specific case.

items.q: Do you offer advice on which cryptocurrencies to buy or how to optimize my investment strategy?
items.a: No. We do not offer investment advice or recommendations on which assets to buy, sell or hold. Our service is strictly technical-tax: financial data analysis, calculation of tax obligations, preparation of AEAT forms and compliance guidance. For investment decisions, we recommend consulting an independent financial advisor.

items.q: What guarantees do you offer on the accuracy of tax calculations?
items.a: All our tax reports are reviewed by certified tax advisors specialized in crypto assets. We apply certified FIFO methodology, full traceability of every calculation and auditable supporting documentation. If we detect errors after delivery, we correct them at no additional cost. Each report includes technical justification and applicable regulatory references.

items.q: How do you guarantee the confidentiality and security of my financial data?
items.a: We process all data in our own secure environments without uploading it to third-party cloud services. We apply end-to-end encryption, role-restricted access and strict data retention policies. We sign confidentiality agreements with every client and comply with GDPR. Your data is deleted from our systems once the legally required retention period ends.

sections.h2: Shall we talk about your case?
sections.body: Tell us about your portfolio: the platforms you use, approximate number of operations, asset types and any relevant tax considerations. We send you an initial evaluation within 24–48 hours, with no commitment. If you have more than 10,000 annual operations, multiple data sources or have received automatic reports with errors, we can help you.

page.intro: At Cleriontax we use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, analyze website traffic, and personalize content. This policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage them.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences (such as language, font size, and other display options) over a period of time, so you don't have to re-enter them whenever you return to the site or browse from one page to another.

necessary.title: Necessary cookies
necessary.description: These cookies are essential for the basic functioning of the website. Without them, the site would not work properly. They include session cookies, language preferences, and cookie consent. They cannot be disabled.
necessary.examples: Examples: Language preferences, cookie consent status.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.
analytics.examples: Examples: Ahrefs Analytics for web traffic analysis.

marketing.title: Marketing cookies
marketing.description: These cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and engaging for the individual user and thereby more valuable for publishers and third-party advertisers.
marketing.examples: Examples: We currently do not use marketing cookies, but we may implement tracking pixels in the future.

howToManage.title: How to manage cookies?
howToManage.content: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time by clicking on the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of our website. You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Here's how to do it in the most popular browsers:

browsers.chrome: Google Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data
browsers.firefox: Mozilla Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data
browsers.safari: Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies and website data

page.title: Privacy Policy
page.intro: At Cleriontax we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Spanish Data Protection Law (LOPDGDD).

retention.title: Data retention
retention.content: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected and to comply with applicable legal obligations. Data related to tax services will be retained for the legally established period (generally 4-6 years).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: In accordance with current regulations, you have the following rights:

items.access: Right of access: know what personal data we have about you
items.rectification: Right of rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data
items.erasure: Right of erasure: request the deletion of your data
items.restriction: Right of restriction: restrict the processing of your data
items.portability: Right of portability: receive your data in a structured format
items.objection: Right of objection: object to the processing of your data
items.withdraw: Right to withdraw consent at any time

rights.howTo: To exercise these rights, you can contact us at info@cleriontax.com. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

security.title: Data security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or alteration. This includes data encryption, access controls, and staff training in data protection.

sharing.title: Data sharing with third parties
sharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We only share your data when:

items.consent: You have given us your consent
items.legal: It is necessary to comply with legal obligations
items.services: It is necessary for the provision of contracted services (for example, with the Tax Agency when you authorize us)

perfiles.entrada: Whoever gets here is usually in one of these four situations. The level of detail and the urgency change; what doesn’t change is that every figure has to be explainable.

A.descripcion: Thousands of transactions, several exchanges, DeFi across several chains. You worry an automated report will leave you exposed.

B.descripcion: Shares, funds and some crypto. You want to file correctly without having to learn the jargon.

C.descripcion: You already have a letter from the AEAT on your desk. You need to know what to do and by when.

D.descripcion: An accounting or advisory firm without crypto expertise. You need technical support and professional backing.
D.enlace: See how we work with firms

lineas.entrada: Four service lines. Every enquiry ends up in one of them, even if it comes in through another door.

informe-fiscal-criptomonedas.descripcion: We consolidate, clean and reconcile data from exchanges, wallets and DeFi protocols into a single, traceable portfolio. Reconciliation is the method; the report is the deliverable.

declarar-criptomonedas.descripcion: We bring your crypto and other asset results into your Spanish income tax return, applying FIFO and the documentation behind every figure.

litigacion-fiscal-criptomonedas.descripcion: We defend you against AEAT requests, reviews and inspections: responses, submissions, appeals, and documentary and on-chain evidence.

asesoria-fiscal-criptomonedas.descripcion: Ongoing advice on your crypto activity and wealth: form 721, tax planning for disposals and estate planning.

metodo.titulo: From exchange, wallet and protocol to a single report
metodo.entrada: An automated report is the starting point, never the deliverable. We bring all your sources together, discard the noise, reconcile what’s duplicated and review by hand what software would settle with a default value.

items.q: Do I have to declare my crypto if I haven’t cashed out to euros?
items.a: Yes, if you’ve swapped one for another. Converting BTC into USDT, for example, is an exchange of assets and produces a capital gain or loss even if you never withdraw euros. If you only bought and hold, that isn’t taxed in income tax, but there may be reporting obligations: form 721 if on 31 December you hold more than 50.000 € in crypto with custodians outside Spain, and form 714 if you are liable for wealth tax.

items.q: Which method is used to calculate the gain?
items.a: FIFO: the first units of a crypto asset you acquired are the first ones deemed sold. The gain or loss is the difference between the disposal value and the acquisition value of those units, fees included. Applying it properly requires the full history: if an old purchase is missing, its acquisition cost can’t be justified.

items.q: Are staking, DeFi and airdrops taxed?
items.a: Yes, though not all in the same way. The Directorate General of Taxes treats staking rewards as investment income and airdrops as a capital gain not arising from a disposal. Swaps on a protocol are exchanges of assets. For liquidity provision and lending, the treatment depends on how each protocol works, and that’s where automated reports tend to get it wrong.

items.q: Why isn’t Koinly or CoinTracking enough?
items.a: Because software doesn’t decide: it applies a default. It counts transfers between your own wallets as sales, leaves purchases without an acquisition cost or values spam tokens as if they were real. They are good tools to start with. We start from their output or from the raw data, review transaction by transaction and write down the criterion behind each figure.

items.q: What do you need from me and how long does it take?
items.a: The CSV files or read-only access to your exchanges and the public addresses of your wallets. With that we run an initial diagnosis. Time and price depend on the volume and complexity of the portfolio: from 3–5 days for simple activity to 2–3 weeks for a multi-chain portfolio with thousands of transactions. These are estimates; we give you a specific one once we see your data.
